<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>CEC immunity challenge:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued notices to the Centre and the Election Commission regarding a plea that challenges the lifelong immunity granted to the Chief Election Commissioner and other commissioners.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Cabinet reshuffle:</strong> L Murugan has resigned as Union Minister of State for Information and Broadcasting to focus on strengthening the BJP in Tamil Nadu, intensifying national speculation regarding a broader Union Cabinet reshuffle.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE5CMTMwUHF1ME5ibElwRXVhdjhMU0RzYWdOLXpVV281TGF3NGNEdnFDd1A0TGRQVUV5UGJYbXZmQTFmVGxNQW90VEUwZC03LTNpZGZVb1hSQUs4eTJuZVdfcnR4T2lkelNyWExOb2g4bUZaaE9qd3VjbVphLXc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
